edges.why_related: the leanest cash stretch overlaps the season when writing new business pays fastest and servicing the existing book pays nothing immediately
edges.resolution_rule: service commitments to existing members are met first; new-business effort is sized to what remains after the book's cadence and review queue are served, and cash pressure is solved with runway planning rather than with member contact

edges.why_related: a member who needs to move soon after enrolling is exactly the case that reverses the agent's payment
edges.resolution_rule: the member's coverage need decides; exposure is never mentioned to the member or weighed against their interest, and the episode is instead recorded as a fit-quality signal for later diagnosis

edges.why_related: a proactive cadence designed to help can be experienced by an older member as repeated unwanted selling
edges.resolution_rule: the member's stated preference and consent record override the designed cadence in every case; a segment's rhythm is a default that any member may reduce or stop, and the stop is honored immediately and permanently

edges.why_related: the review queue and the service desk peak in the same weeks and compete for the same single pair of hands
edges.resolution_rule: clock-critical member harm outranks any scheduled review; reviews are re-sequenced and, if capacity still fails, the practice reduces new-business intake rather than skipping the highest-need review segments

edges.why_related: service contact is the moment of maximum goodwill and therefore the most tempting and least appropriate moment to ask for referrals
edges.resolution_rule: no referral request is made inside a call about an unresolved member problem or with a member whose comprehension is in question; referral conversations occur only in settled contact and never with anything of value attached

edges.why_related: protecting an attribution position can quietly become a reason to discourage a member from a move or from calling another channel
edges.resolution_rule: the member's interest and freedom of choice win; attribution is never protected by discouraging a member, and a loss is answered by asking what need went unmet rather than by contacting the member to reclaim the position

edges.why_related: servicing well argues for recording more about a member's health and household, while protecting a vulnerable consumer argues for holding as little as possible
edges.resolution_rule: record only what servicing actually requires and can be justified as minimum necessary; when in doubt record the fact needed for the next action rather than the underlying detail behind it

edges.why_related: answered calls and kept callback promises are the mechanism by which members decide to stay
how a failure is handled moves retention further than whether the failure happened
unresolved pharmacy-cost events are one of the largest identifiable causes of mid-year and annual exits
a detected life event frequently changes the member's continuation state and therefore what the statement should show
the expected-member ledger is derived from the files before any statement is opened
status changes gathered through the year are what make the review queue accurate when it is built
exits can only be classified once the review cycle has closed and the outcomes are known
segments shown to be leaving disproportionately get their cadence and intake path rebuilt
fit failures found in the exit analysis change what the next review cycle checks first
each recovered failure adds the missing field or checkpoint that would have prevented it
both are mid-year shocks worked the same way: confirm at the source, establish exposure under the current plan, explain educationally, and route any election question rather than answering it

conflict_axes.name: service_promise_versus_servicing_capacity
conflict_axes.description: The promise that makes a member call you first is the same promise that overwhelms a one-person practice when several members need real work in the same week.
poles: promise full year-round service to every member
commit only to what the practice can deliver at quality
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: state the promise narrowly and honestly, then size the book and cadence to it; when capacity fails, reduce intake before reducing service to existing members

conflict_axes.name: compensation_consequence_versus_member_interest
conflict_axes.description: Almost every stay-or-move decision in a book has a compensation consequence the agent can see and the member cannot, in both directions.
poles: let the economics of the decision inform the advice
decide on member-side facts alone and record them
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: member-side facts decide, always; the compensation consequence is documented nowhere in the recommendation and the member-side reason is recorded at the time of the decision

conflict_axes.name: proactive_contact_versus_contact_restraint
conflict_axes.description: Reaching out before a problem appears is real service; reaching out repeatedly to a protected population is exactly what the contact rules restrain.
poles: contact often so problems are caught early
contact rarely and only as the member consented
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: cadence is a default set by need and bounded by consent; the member's stated preference always overrides the segment's rhythm and a stop request is permanent

conflict_axes.name: helpfulness_versus_role_boundary
conflict_axes.description: The member wants the agent to handle the appeal, pick the drug and argue with the carrier, and the agent is not permitted to do any of those things.
poles: do whatever the member needs done
help only within the licensed and permitted role
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: explain the process, protect the deadline, assemble what the member authorizes, and hand the parts requiring representation or clinical judgment to the counseling program, the prescriber or an appointed representative

conflict_axes.name: annual_window_throughput_versus_review_quality
conflict_axes.description: The same weeks must absorb the whole book's reviews, a peak in inbound service, and the carrier deadlines that do not move.
poles: review everyone even if each review is thin
review well even if some members are reached late
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: sequence by need with the highest-risk segments first, start weeks before the window, and cut new-business intake before cutting review depth for members whose plan is changing

conflict_axes.name: keeping_the_member_versus_keeping_the_payment
conflict_axes.description: Retaining a member and retaining an attribution position feel identical until the member's better option lies somewhere the agent is not paid.
poles: protect the attribution position
serve the member wherever that leads
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: serve the member; treat an attribution loss as a diagnostic question about unmet need, never as a reason to contact the member to reclaim the position

conflict_axes.name: speed_of_answer_versus_verified_accuracy
conflict_axes.description: A frightened member wants an answer on the first call, while the facts that matter live in carrier directories, notices and statements that take days to confirm.
poles: answer immediately from what is known
answer only after confirming at the source
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: give the member the mechanism and the next step immediately, name what still has to be confirmed and by when, and never let an unconfirmed fact drive an election

conflict_axes.name: family_involvement_versus_beneficiary_autonomy
conflict_axes.description: Adult children and caregivers often manage the practical side of a member's life while the decision remains legally and ethically the beneficiary's.
poles: work with whoever manages the member's affairs
deal only with the beneficiary absent documented authority
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: involve a third party only with the member's recorded authorization, keep the competent beneficiary as the decision-maker, and pause rather than proceed when the two disagree

conflict_axes.name: book_growth_versus_service_quality
conflict_axes.description: Every added member increases income and decreases the attention available to everyone already in the book.
poles: grow the book while the growth is available
cap the book at the size one agent can serve honestly
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: let the cadence and review capacity define the ceiling; grow only after service commitments are demonstrably being met, and add capacity before adding members

conflict_axes.name: record_depth_versus_privacy_minimalism
conflict_axes.description: Better servicing argues for knowing more about a member's health, household and finances; the privacy obligations owed to that member argue for holding as little as possible.
poles: record everything that might help later
record only the minimum necessary to service
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: record the operational fact needed for the next action rather than the underlying detail, review holdings periodically, and treat any collection the member would be surprised by as out of scope

edge_cases.description: A member's adult daughter calls to change her mother's plan; the mother is not on the phone and no authorization is on file
edge_cases.trigger: a third party attempts to direct an election or a plan discussion
edge_cases.mitigation: answer only general educational questions, decline to discuss the member's specifics or any election without the member present or a recorded authorization, and offer to schedule a call the member joins

edge_cases.description: Mid-review the member repeats the same question three times and cannot name the medications she takes daily
edge_cases.trigger: signs of cognitive difficulty appear during a decision-bearing conversation
edge_cases.mitigation: stop the decision path, make no election that day, offer to continue when a person the member chooses can join with the member's authorization, and record what was observed factually without diagnosing anything

edge_cases.description: A member you enrolled quietly stops appearing on a carrier statement with no disenrollment notice and no complaint
edge_cases.trigger: an expected statement line disappears between cycles
edge_cases.mitigation: check attribution in the carrier portal before assuming an error, separate a reporting lag from an attribution change, file a dispute with evidence inside the carrier's window if the enrollment stands, and keep servicing the member either way

edge_cases.description: A member disenrolls weeks after enrolling, reversing the payment, and then calls the agent for help with the plan they moved to
edge_cases.trigger: an early exit within the recovery-exposed period followed by a service request
edge_cases.mitigation: serve the request within the agent's role regardless of the reversal, record the exit reason for the fit-quality analysis, and let no part of the reversal enter the conversation with the member

edge_cases.description: A carrier announces it is discontinuing a plan that a large share of the book holds for the coming year
edge_cases.trigger: a plan exit or market withdrawal announced ahead of the annual window
edge_cases.mitigation: identify the affected members immediately, move them to the front of the review queue with extra time budgeted, prepare an educational explanation of what the discontinuation means, and route each member's window question to the enrollment path rather than answering it in bulk

edge_cases.description: A member calls in July with a real coverage problem and no obvious qualifying event
edge_cases.trigger: a mid-year need arises outside any evident enrollment window
edge_cases.mitigation: work the problem inside the current plan first, explain window classes only in general educational terms, route any eligibility determination to the enrollment path with the required artifact, and never assert that a right to change exists

edge_cases.description: An orphan member with no attributed agent calls for help with a plan the agent did not write
edge_cases.trigger: a servicing request arrives from a member the agent is not paid on
edge_cases.mitigation: apply the practice's written orphan policy: help within the role and within available capacity, do not condition help on any attribution change, and record the contact like any other

edge_cases.description: A member is standing at the pharmacy counter without a critical medication because the claim rejected
edge_cases.trigger: an immediate access problem with clinical urgency
edge_cases.mitigation: treat as the highest clock class, get the pharmacist and the carrier onto the rejection reason the same day, ask about any transitional or emergency supply provisions the plan may have, and involve the prescriber for anything clinical rather than advising on the medication

edge_cases.description: Another party is pressuring a member to switch plans with urgency language, and the member calls confused and frightened
edge_cases.trigger: suspected pressure selling or exploitation of a protected consumer
edge_cases.mitigation: do not answer pressure with pressure; explain the member's own current coverage factually, tell the member they may take any time they need and may contact the carrier, the federal help line or the state counseling program independently, record what the member reported, and escalate suspected exploitation through the appropriate official channel

edge_cases.description: The annual review queue is larger than the days remaining and some members will not be reached before the window closes
edge_cases.trigger: review capacity is exceeded during the window
edge_cases.mitigation: re-sequence by exposure so members whose plan is changing most are reached first, tell the remaining members plainly and early what will happen and when they will be contacted, stop new-business intake before shortening reviews, and record the shortfall as a capacity finding for the next cycle

edge_cases.description: The agent loses an appointment with a carrier mid-year through termination or a missed certification deadline
edge_cases.trigger: an appointment or certification lapse affecting part of the book
edge_cases.mitigation: stop any activity the lapse no longer permits for those members, read the agreement for what happens to attribution and payment, tell affected members factually how to get help and through which channel, and execute the continuity plan rather than leaving them to discover it

edge_cases.description: A member asks the agent to sign and file an appeal on their behalf as their representative
edge_cases.trigger: a request that would place the agent outside the permitted role
edge_cases.mitigation: decline the representative role plainly, explain who may serve as an appointed representative and how the member appoints one, help assemble documents the member authorizes, protect the printed deadline, and refer to the state counseling program or the carrier's advocacy channel

workflow.action: Write the post-enrollment service promise and its limits
workflow.description: State what the practice does for a member after enrollment, what only the carrier or a government channel can do, and how the member reaches the agent
workflow.artifact: written service promise given to members and used in the practice
workflow.gate: the promise names the agent's obligations, the explicit role limits, and the contact path, and is the version members actually receive

workflow.action: Adopt the vulnerable-consumer contact discipline as a standing rule
workflow.description: Fix pace, plain language, comprehension checks, authorization requirements and the immediate honoring of contact preferences before any outreach exists
workflow.artifact: contact conduct standard with the comprehension-check and authorization rules
workflow.gate: the standard specifies the comprehension check, the third-party authorization requirement and the do-not-contact handling, and is applied to every channel in use

workflow.action: Adopt the compensation-neutrality rule and its documentation requirement
workflow.description: Establish that member-side facts decide every stay-or-move outcome and that the reason is recorded at the time of the decision
workflow.artifact: neutrality rule with the member-side reason field defined in the file structure
workflow.gate: the rule is written, the reason field exists in the record, and stay decisions are documented to the same standard as changes

workflow.action: Stand up the member service record
workflow.description: Build the per-member file holding plan, providers, drugs, pharmacy, artifacts, contacts, open items, authorizations and status flags
workflow.artifact: member file structure populated for the existing book
workflow.gate: any member can be opened to a current state with the date each element was last confirmed, and open items carry owners and dates

workflow.action: Map the compensation mechanism and verify the current plan year
workflow.description: Record the parts of the mechanism per product class and verify current-year values against the published schedule and each carrier addendum
workflow.artifact: per-carrier compensation mechanism sheet with dated source references
workflow.gate: every product class has a dated current-year source reference and no planning figure traces to memory or a verbal claim

workflow.action: Determine payment level and continuation status per member
workflow.description: Work each member's enrollment history against current-year class definitions and record the determination in the file
workflow.artifact: per-member level and continuation determination with the history facts behind it
workflow.gate: every active member has a dated determination citing the guidance class used, and none of it appears in member-facing material

workflow.action: Verify agent-of-record status across the book
workflow.description: Check attribution per carrier portal on a fixed cycle and record losses, suspected causes and the service response
workflow.artifact: attribution status list per carrier with check dates and exception log
workflow.gate: the cycle is defined and met, each loss has a date and cause class, and a written policy exists for serving unattributed members

workflow.action: Reconcile statements to the member ledger every cycle
workflow.description: Compare each carrier and pass-through statement line by line against the ledger derived from the member files and classify every unmatched line
workflow.artifact: reconciliation worksheet with unmatched lines, cause classes and dated disputes
workflow.gate: the cycle is complete at member level, every unmatched line carries a cause class, and disputes cite evidence and were filed inside the stated window

workflow.action: Build the service desk intake and routing rules
workflow.description: Define resolver classes, clock sensitivity tests, the election-touch stop rule, severity by segment, and the callback commitment
workflow.artifact: triage intake form and routing rules in daily use
workflow.gate: every intake in the period records resolver, clock class, election-touch flag, owner and promised callback, and clock-critical items were worked first

workflow.action: Segment the book and set the contact cadence against real capacity
workflow.description: Assign every member to a need-based segment with a defined touch pattern, then reconcile the total against available hours and the window load
workflow.artifact: segmented book with per-segment cadence and a capacity reconciliation
workflow.gate: every member has a segment and cadence, the total is shown to fit the hours available, and outreach lists are filtered by consent records

workflow.action: Run the annual review cycle from the file, starting before the window
workflow.description: Prepare each review from the member file against the plan's change notice, contact within the permitted rules, cover the member's own plan first, and record the outcome including no-change
workflow.artifact: review queue with dated outcomes for every member in the book
workflow.gate: every member has a dated outcome, artifacts precede any specific-plan discussion, and the queue order is explainable by need and timing rather than expected payment

workflow.action: Classify the year's exits and route each finding upstream
workflow.description: After the window closes, classify every exit as structural, fit, service or attribution, cohort them, and assign each defect to the practice that must change
workflow.artifact: exit analysis with cohorts and a routed defect list
workflow.gate: every exit carries a class and evidence, cohorting covers source, plan and enrollment month, and each defect names an owning practice and a recorded change

priority_rationale: The duty frame and its two guardrails come first because every later action in a book — a call, a review, a referral, a reconciliation — is legal or illegal, ethical or exploitative, on the strength of those three; the member file follows because reconciliation, triage, review and diagnostics all read from it; the compensation mechanism, level determination, attribution and reconciliation come next because they are what makes income legible without ever entering advice; the service-desk units then sit on triage because misrouting harms members and creates rework; the annual review and cadence compose file, guardrails and service into the year's main cycle; and persistency diagnostics, referral growth and continuity come last because they read the finished book and feed their findings back upstream.

dominance_rules.rule: Compliance with the current-year rules dominates every retention, service and growth objective
dominance_rules.rationale: in this vertical a single contact, artifact or inducement violation can end the appointments the entire book depends on, and no amount of service quality survives losing them
dominance_rules.trigger: any servicing, review or growth action that touches contact permission, artifacts, inducements or prohibited practices
dominance_rules.action: stop, verify the rule as it stands for the current plan year and jurisdiction, and proceed only inside it or not at all

dominance_rules.rule: The member's interest dominates every compensation consequence in both directions
dominance_rules.rationale: steering is the allegation class that ends practices, and the temptation exists equally when a change pays and when staying pays
dominance_rules.trigger: a stay-or-move decision where the agent can foresee a payment, a level change or a reversal
dominance_rules.action: decide on member-side facts alone, record that reason at the time, and keep the compensation consequence out of the conversation and the file's reasoning entirely

dominance_rules.rule: Beneficiary autonomy dominates family and caregiver preference absent documented authority
dominance_rules.rationale: the decision is legally and ethically the beneficiary's, and the pressure that harms this population most often arrives from inside the household
dominance_rules.trigger: a third party directs, urges or attempts to complete a decision for a member
dominance_rules.action: proceed only with the member present or a recorded authorization, keep a competent beneficiary as the decision-maker, and pause when the two disagree

dominance_rules.rule: Time-critical member harm dominates all scheduled work
dominance_rules.rationale: a printed appeal deadline or a member without medication cannot be rescheduled, while a review can
dominance_rules.trigger: an intake shows a printed deadline, a coverage cutoff or an immediate access problem
dominance_rules.action: work the clock-critical item first, re-sequence the day's queue, and record what was displaced

dominance_rules.rule: A verified source dominates remembered knowledge in every coverage, network, formulary and compensation statement
dominance_rules.rationale: everything in this business is republished annually and the confident memory is exactly what produces the wrong advice
dominance_rules.trigger: any statement about coverage, network status, drug status, a rule or a payment that is about to be relied on
dominance_rules.action: confirm at the current source, date the confirmation in the file, and state clearly to the member what is not yet confirmed

dominance_rules.rule: The stop-and-obtain-permission rule dominates conversational momentum
dominance_rules.rationale: the artifact requirement does not bend because the member raised the topic or because the moment is convenient
dominance_rules.trigger: a service conversation moves toward a different plan or a new election
dominance_rules.action: pause the topic, obtain the required artifact before discussing any specific plan, and record who introduced the subject

dominance_rules.rule: The member's stated contact preference dominates the practice's outreach design
dominance_rules.rationale: consent is both the legal basis for contact and the practical measure of whether outreach is service or nuisance
dominance_rules.trigger: a member limits contact, changes channel or asks not to be contacted
dominance_rules.action: apply it immediately and permanently to every list and campaign, and record the date it was applied

dominance_rules.rationale: an under-served book generates the complaints, the exits and the reversals that cost more than the new members were worth
dominance_rules.trigger: cadence commitments or review completion fall behind while new business is being added
dominance_rules.action: pause intake, restore service to the existing book, and add capacity before resuming growth

dominance_rules.rule: Documenting the member-side reason dominates finishing the interaction quickly
dominance_rules.rationale: the reason is the only defence available years later when a complaint or audit asks why an outcome happened
dominance_rules.trigger: any decision, recommendation or plan change is concluded with a member
dominance_rules.action: record the member-side reason, the date and the evidence before the next contact is started

dominance_rules.rule: Serving the member dominates protecting the attribution position
dominance_rules.rationale: attribution is a carrier-side attribute the agent does not own, and defending it against a member's interest is the behaviour the rules exist to prevent
dominance_rules.trigger: an attribution position is at risk because a member's better option lies elsewhere or they have used another channel
dominance_rules.action: serve or hand off cleanly, ask what need went unmet, and never contact the member to reclaim the position

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the service promise and its limits before taking on servicing volume
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unbounded implied promise that has to be renegotiated later with members who are already disappointed

anti_rework_rules.rule: Stand up the member file before the first annual review cycle
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rebuilding every member's drug, provider and pharmacy list by interview under window time pressure

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify current-year compensation classes before modeling any income
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a practice plan built on a stale schedule that must be corrected mid-year after the money does not arrive

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify attribution across the book before reconciling statements
anti_rework_rules.prevents: disputing lines the agent was never entitled to while silent attribution losses continue undetected

anti_rework_rules.rule: Re-establish the required permission and appointment artifact before any plan-specific discussion
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an unusable enrollment and a full repeat of a conversation an older member should not have to have twice

anti_rework_rules.rule: Segment the book and size the cadence against real hours before the annual window opens
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a triage collapse in the final week where the highest-need members are the ones reached last or not at all

anti_rework_rules.rule: Obtain the actual document before advising on a denial, a bill, a network claim or a statement
anti_rework_rules.prevents: advice built on a paraphrase that has to be withdrawn and re-given once the notice is finally read

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the member-side reason at the moment of the decision, not at the end of the day
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reconstructing intent months later during a complaint or audit, when the memory of that specific call is gone

anti_rework_rules.rule: Classify the resolver before promising a member any resolution
anti_rework_rules.prevents: days spent chasing an outcome only the carrier, the pharmacy or a federal agency could ever have produced

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the actual carrier and upline agreement terms before changing hierarchy, adding a carrier or planning succession
anti_rework_rules.prevents: discovering after the move that renewals, release rights or attribution do not work the way they were described

iteration_protocol.trigger: annual change notices and next-year plan data are published
iteration_protocol.action: refresh every member's fit checkpoints from the file, rebuild the review queue in need order, and re-verify the segments that will need the most time

iteration_protocol.trigger: a compensation schedule or a carrier compensation addendum is republished or amended
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the mechanism sheet, redo per-member level determinations affected by the change, and reset reconciliation expectations before the next cycle

iteration_protocol.trigger: a statement line disappears or a payment level does not match the determination
iteration_protocol.action: check attribution first, then reporting lag, then processing, and file an evidence-based dispute inside the carrier's window if the enrollment stands

iteration_protocol.trigger: reversals rise within an identifiable cohort, plan or enrollment source
iteration_protocol.action: trace each reversal to a cause class, cohort by enrollment month and source, and route the fit or process defect upstream rather than treating it as carrier noise

iteration_protocol.trigger: a carrier exits a market or discontinues a plan a segment of the book holds
iteration_protocol.action: identify affected members immediately, move them to the front of the review queue with extra time, and route each member's window question to the enrollment path individually

iteration_protocol.trigger: a service failure, a missed callback or a member complaint surfaces
iteration_protocol.action: acknowledge and repair with a named owner and date, decide whether reporting is required, and add the missing checkpoint to the record structure so the class cannot recur

iteration_protocol.trigger: contact, communication or inducement rules are restated for the plan year
iteration_protocol.action: re-check the crossing rule, the cadence design and every referral practice against the new statement before the next outreach batch goes out

iteration_protocol.trigger: a carrier or upline agreement is amended, or an appointment is added, terminated or lapses
iteration_protocol.action: re-read the release, assignment and post-termination terms, update the continuity plan, and re-check what may still be done for the affected members

iteration_protocol.trigger: a member shows signs of impairment, or an authorization or representative designation changes
iteration_protocol.action: pause decision-bearing conversations, update the authorization record, adjust the contact approach and segment, and note factually what was observed without diagnosing
